value.title: Seats stuck on a modal dialog look working (F47)

sections.name: body
sections.value: pm-001 asked 2026-11-07 22:56 to add this to the watch. A Copilot seat can sit on a modal question or follow-up dialog while pij shows it working (herring, 21:01 to 22:55 on 07 Nov). When a seat has had no model call for 30+ min (lastCallAtMs in pij-rs --json list sessionStatus, or a quiet pane), tmux capture-pane it. ctrl+d declines the dialog; the PA brief says never click dialogs, so report it to the seat's owner or the prime first unless pm-001 or the prime has said to dismiss.
